title: Fixture deliveries
description:
Write the test helpers from lesson 4.05: signed deliveries built in code, and the bad variants every receiver must reject.

```python
def make_delivery(secret, event, timestamp, path="/webhooks", method="POST", sign_with=None, header=True): ...
def variants(secret, event, timestamp): ...
```

**make_delivery** returns the raw HTTP request as `bytes`:

- The body is `json.dumps(event, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)` encoded as UTF-8.
- The head is these lines, each ending `\r\n`, followed by an empty line (`\r\n`): `<method> <path> HTTP/1.1`, `Host: localhost`, `Content-Type: application/json`, `Content-Length: <body length in bytes>`, and, if `header` is true, `Webhook-Signature: t=<timestamp>,v1=<hex>`.
- The signature is the HMAC-SHA256 of `f"{timestamp}."` plus the body, keyed with `sign_with` if given, otherwise `secret`.

**variants** returns a dict of named deliveries for the same event, all at `timestamp` unless stated:

| Name | Delivery |
|---|---|
| `valid` | correctly signed |
| `wrong_secret` | signed with `secret + b"-wrong"` |
| `old` | correctly signed, but with the timestamp one hour (3600 s) earlier |
| `unsigned` | no signature header |
| `get` | correctly signed, but with method `GET` |
| `changed_body` | the `valid` delivery with the **last byte of the body** replaced by a space (the length stays the same) |

solution.solution.py:
import hashlib
import hmac
import json


def make_delivery(secret, event, timestamp, path="/webhooks", method="POST", sign_with=None, header=True):
    body = json.dumps(event, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")
    key = sign_with if sign_with is not None else secret
    signature = hmac.new(key, f"{timestamp}.".encode("ascii") + body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    lines = [f"{method} {path} HTTP/1.1", "Host: localhost", "Content-Type: application/json", f"Content-Length: {len(body)}"]
    if header:
        lines.append(f"Webhook-Signature: t={timestamp},v1={signature}")
    return ("\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n\r\n").encode("latin-1") + body


def variants(secret, event, timestamp):
    valid = make_delivery(secret, event, timestamp)
    return {
        "valid": valid,
        "wrong_secret": make_delivery(secret, event, timestamp, sign_with=secret + b"-wrong"),
        "old": make_delivery(secret, event, timestamp - 3600),
        "unsigned": make_delivery(secret, event, timestamp, header=False),
        "get": make_delivery(secret, event, timestamp, method="GET"),
        "changed_body": valid[:-1] + b" ",
    }

import hashlib, hmac, json

SECRET = b"whsec_test"
EVENT = {"type": "order.paid", "id": "evt_1", "data": {"order": "o_42", "note": "café"}}

def split(raw):
    head, _, body = raw.partition(b"\r\n\r\n")
    lines = head.decode("latin-1").split("\r\n")
    headers = dict(line.split(": ", 1) for line in lines[1:])
    return lines[0], headers, body

def genuine(raw, secret, now):
    _line, headers, body = split(raw)
    sig = headers.get("Webhook-Signature")
    if not sig:
        return False
    t = int(sig.split(",")[0][2:])
    v1 = sig.split(",")[1][3:]
    expected = hmac.new(secret, f"{t}.".encode() + body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return abs(now - t) <= 300 and hmac.compare_digest(expected, v1)

@test("a valid delivery")
def _():
    raw = make_delivery(SECRET, EVENT, 1000)
    line, headers, body = split(raw)
    check_eq(line, "POST /webhooks HTTP/1.1")
    check_eq(headers["Host"], "localhost")
    check_eq(headers["Content-Type"], "application/json")
    check_eq(body, json.dumps(EVENT, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True).encode())
    check_eq(int(headers["Content-Length"]), len(body))
    check(genuine(raw, SECRET, 1000))
    check_eq(list(headers), ["Host", "Content-Type", "Content-Length", "Webhook-Signature"])

@test("options")
def _():
    line, headers, _b = split(make_delivery(SECRET, EVENT, 1000, path="/hooks/v2", method="PUT"))
    check_eq(line, "PUT /hooks/v2 HTTP/1.1")
    _l, headers, _b = split(make_delivery(SECRET, EVENT, 1000, header=False))
    check("Webhook-Signature" not in headers)
    check(not genuine(make_delivery(SECRET, EVENT, 1000, sign_with=b"other"), SECRET, 1000))

@test("the variants")
def _():
    v = variants(SECRET, EVENT, 5000)
    check_eq(sorted(v), ["changed_body", "get", "old", "unsigned", "valid", "wrong_secret"])
    check(genuine(v["valid"], SECRET, 5000))
    check(not genuine(v["wrong_secret"], SECRET, 5000))
    check(not genuine(v["old"], SECRET, 5000))
    check(genuine(v["old"], SECRET, 1400))
    check(not genuine(v["unsigned"], SECRET, 5000))
    check(genuine(v["get"], SECRET, 5000) and split(v["get"])[0].startswith("GET "))
    check(not genuine(v["changed_body"], SECRET, 5000))
    check_eq(len(v["changed_body"]), len(v["valid"]))
